item: STORY - the UAE split (verified 21 Sep 2026). CLAIM: Dubai prices went negative year on year this summer for the first time since June 2021 - PIX Aug-26 205.6, -3.5% YoY as published (live series after late registrations 207.0, -2.4%), about -6% from the Jan-May plateau of ~220. Dubai off-plan growth went from +12.8% YoY (Dec-25) to +0.1% (Aug-26). Abu Dhabi same window: ValuStrat index +17.8% YoY, off-plan 6,061 sales = 84% of all sales, +156% YoY, off-plan avg 2,104 psf +21.2% YoY. | RECEIPTS: propertyindex.ae/dubai-real-estate-price-index/2026-08 (DLD-registered, mix-adjusted, series CSV on /download); ValuStrat Abu Dhabi Real Estate Review Q2 2026 pp.7-13 (PDF in content-assets/research/, data to 30 Jun = a quarter old, indicative not register-verified). | ANGLE: 'I moved where the money moved' - Calum to Modon / Abu Dhabi from 5 Oct, invested himself (Tara Park, Hudayriyat). HONEST BEAT that makes it credible: Abu Dhabi is not immune - transacted psf fell on the quarter in Q2 (off-plan -4%, ready -4.3%), index growth +2.1% q = weakest in two years, and AD off-plan sits ~46% over ready vs ~24% in Dubai. DO NOT SAY: 'seven straight monthly declines' or 'Dec-25 peak 223.2' - killed, current series shows Apr and May up and only three falls (Jun, Jul, Aug). DO NOT compare +21.2% with +0.1% as like-for-like - one is a raw average psf, the other mix-adjusted; use +17.8% index vs -3.5% index and say methods differ. Rent freeze line if wanted: ADREC cut the cap 5% to 0% on 2 Jun 2026, temporary, until further notice - adrec.gov.ae press release 3 Jun 2026; ADGM areas (Maryah, parts of Reem) carved out per Baker McKenzie - check before saying it on a Reem piece.

Owner data now in PRIVATE repo: crm-inbox data/owners/damac-lagoons-owners.json (8,843 Lagoons units, 3MB) + README.md. Requests: 1) agentkit getfile fails over 1MB - add an 'owner <unit|name|cluster>' command using the raw media type, returning matching rows only; 2) propose one line for _shared.md Source of truth pointing all agents at private:data/owners/README.md (Calum approves the rule change).

Task dashboard: Calum wants it finished. Known gaps from PA audit 21 Sep: difficulty is text (easy/medium/hard) so points never compute (0 done, 0 open) - map to 1/3/5/8 or score numerically; 226 done tasks + 51 active in one file - archive done to data/archive/; overdue items show nothing - surface count + oldest; ids are a mix of UUIDs and slugs; buildLog/units arrays empty; Top 3 flag not enforced to max three. Calum to add what he sees broken. Task task-dashboard-sort-2209 due Mon 28 Sep.

Buyers dashboard: new field closedLost (YYYY-MM-DD) on buyer records set when stage goes to Lost. Calum wants the Lost section sorted by closedLost descending, most recent at the top, always. Older Lost records have no date - sort them to the bottom, do not invent dates.

Buyer card notes render: notes is one string, entries separated by ' | ', newest first, each entry starts with a date ('22 Sep: ...' or '2026-09-02: ...'). Calum wants it readable: split on ' | ', one line per entry, date as gold eyebrow, newest at top, show 3 then 'more'. Same for stock/seller notes. PA will keep writing that format; if you'd rather move to notes[] array + history[], say so and PA migrates the data in one pass.
06:30/18:30 Inbox sweep has not produced a triage file on 22 or 23 Sep (data/triage/ only has .keep). Check the scheduled task fired and can write the file; PA opens the brief on it.

Buyer data migration (spec tools/specs/2026-09-23-agentkit-v2.md section 1, after Claude Code ships v2): 1) status derived from stage - Won->'Closed Won', Lost->'Closed Lost', else 'Active' (16 Active+Lost, 1 Active+Won, 3 'Won' to fix); 2) stage Viewed->Viewing (3), Qualifying->Qualified (1); 3) closedDate (21) -> closedWon or closedLost per stage, then remove closedDate; never invent a date; 4) archive-buyers: lostReason = old status, stage Lost + status 'Closed Lost' for Inactive/Archived/Bought Elsewhere; the 5 'Bought' - check deals.json, Calum's deal = Won else lostReason Bought Elsewhere; the 2 'Active' in archive - revive to buyers.json or Lost, ask Calum once; 5) acceptance: agentkit.py buyers-check reads '-- 0 violations' on buyers.json.
